Dear Stakeholder,
The survey below has been prepared to assess your opinions and expectations regarding the service we provide as Gebze Technical University's Directorate of Student Affairs. Your evaluations will offer insights for us and guide our activities to serve you better. Therefore, careful completion of the survey is important. We thank you for your concern and contributions.
Please indicate your position at the institution:
☐ Student ☐ Academic Staff ☐ Administrative Staff | 10
Please provide your level of agreement with the evaluation statements in the survey using the evaluation scale below.
5- I Strongly Agree 4- I Agree 3- I Neither Agree or Disagree 2- I Disagree 1- I Strongly Disagree N/A: Not Applicable
We kindly request that you provide objective evidence for the statements you evaluated as 1 or 2 for us to be able take your evaluation into account.
EVALUATION STATEMENTS | 5 | 4 | 3 | 2 | 1 | N/A
1 | I am satisfied with the service I receive from the Directorate of Student Affairs.
2 | I am satisfied with the attitude of the staff whom I receive service from.
3 | Announcements made by the Directorate of Student Affairs are sufficient.
4 | My information and document requests from the Directorate of Student Affairs are completed on time.
5 | I am satisfied with the activities of the Scholarships Branch under the Directorate of Student Affairs.
6 | I am satisfied with the activities of the Alumni Unit under the Directorate of Student Affairs.
7 | I am satisfied with the activities of the Alumni Coordination Office under the Directorate of Student Affairs.
